claim_dimensions.geometric_fidelity: Equality of the specified exact polyhedra. No analytic-surface or earlier approximate-intent proof follows.
claim_dimensions.numerical_certainty: Every operation and each nonempty PWN validation must report Certified under STRICT.
claim_dimensions.topology: Nonempty closed PWN; no universal manifold claim for touching/XOR outputs. Canonical empty is accepted by the modeling boundary and is tested independently.

limitations: Exact rational chart recovery depends on the native scalar recognizer; inability to recover a chart coordinate is an oracle limitation, not proof of an incorrect set.

Rational arithmetic and the separately checked native PWN validator remain trusted dependencies. This is an independent set oracle, not a second independent arbitrary-precision arithmetic implementation or formal proof.
The named finite domain and one test execution order do not exhaust symbolic expressions, mesh families, cache histories or thread schedules.
External containment does not establish internal total-work, retained-memory or cancellation guarantees. Runtime API, certainty provenance, interchange and release contracts are unchanged.
negative_controls: Each of five frames transforms two disjoint volume-eight boxes, accepts the expected box and requires the other to fail with cell winding. No Boolean or native containment call appears in the oracle.
owner: Modeling composition acceptance tests; source arithmetic and topology remain in their native layers.

prior_review_helper_failure.failure: Whitespace-only comparison rejected rustfmt-added match-arm commas and block wrapping. No source mutation or review result was produced. Version 2 formats the original observation using the repository configuration before comparing unchanged bodies.

promoted_original_bodies_preserved_after: rational arithmetic and full grid/ray oracle
proof_argument: The five explicit affine inverse charts invert their stated matrices exactly; reflection reverses triangle orientation when returning to the source chart. Every recovered coordinate must have a proved exact rational normal form.

Every triangle is nondegenerate, is contained in the source bounds, and lies on one of the source box coordinate planes. Open cells of those planes contain no mesh boundary; winding is constant on each cell.

Rational box inequalities and the four Boolean truth tables independently determine expected membership on each cell. A rational ray in the positive x direction counts signed crossings using only Rational arithmetic. Faces parallel to the ray have zero projected area and do not cross a ray through an open cell.

Projected edge-line intersection with the scaled and translated curve (1/(k+2),1/(k+3)) has a nonzero polynomial of degree at most two. At most 3*T edge lines exclude at most 6*T integer trials; 6*T+1 trials include a nondegenerate ray.

The finite padded grid covers all possible nonzero winding because every output vertex stays inside the source bounds. Matching nonzero winding on every open cell establishes equality of the regularized polyhedral sets including closures.
Independent occupied-cell volumes are summed exactly and compared with the oriented tetrahedral volume. This is additional evidence; same-volume wrong-set controls require a membership rejection.
retry_controls: Each frame applies to a hand-retriangulated x=2 face with fan center (2,1,2/3). Native certified PWN validation and exact set audit pass, while ray_trials must exceed cells.
